services.name: Yoga Serves Potluck
services.desc: AASY Weekend Intensives are an in-person event, not Zoomed. To enroll for the weekend, purchase a Weekend Intensive Pass and reserve in each class you will attend. 10 hours of in-depth Asana classes that include asana from all categories of poses, including inversions with variations, difficult backbends, and balancings. Students should have a minimum of 3 years experience in Iyengar Yoga, and be able to hold independent inversions for at least 5 minutes. 2 hours of Pranayama classes covering seated, supine, and digital pranayamas.6 hours of master classes covering Iyengar methodology that will focus on developing a better understanding of the Iyengar Yoga method. services.name: Class Descriptions
services.desc: General Classes - The General classes are the heart of our program, where the students most develop and progress in the method. These classes are progressive and transforming for the students as they evolve their practice. All classes are recorded using Zoom. If enrolled and marked as having attended every student will have access to the recordings for two weeks following the class. They are accessed through the students punchpass account in the Content Library. All Online Classes: Online students must have a mat, 3-5 blankets, belt, and block, and, if possible, a yoga chair and bolster should be available at home.
